sections.title: Save the useful bits. Find them when it counts.
sections.lede: Keep copied text and images searchable, grouped, and ready to use again.

items.title: Keep more than the last copy
items.body: Capture text, code, URLs, and image buffers in a searchable history while Cache Vault is active.

items.title: Bring a clip back fast
items.body: Search saved clips in Quick Paste and copy one back without losing your place in the current app.

items.title: Keep related clips together
items.body: Pin Favorites and organize clips into named Safes and Collections.

items.title: Review before cleanup
items.body: See grouped duplicate suggestions and choose what to keep or remove.

items.title: Take a record with you
items.body: Export selected clips with a readable index, a machine-readable manifest, and a stamped receipt.

items.title: What data is captured by Cache Vault?
items.body: Text snippets, developer code, URLs, and image buffers copied to your system clipboard while Cache Vault is active.

items.title: Is my clipboard data uploaded to the cloud?
items.body: No cloud account or cloud storage is required. Core desktop features work locally on your machine. The optional Android companion communicates directly with your desktop over your local network.

items.title: Where is clip history stored?
items.body: Clips are stored in a profile-isolated local database within your local profile application data directory.

items.title: How do portable exports work?
items.body: Selected collections are exported to a portable folder/ZIP containing an index.html file for reading, a manifest.json for parsing, and a stamped_receipt.txt recording export details.
